answer.says: You are right, Sunil. I confused the chemical with the ontological. The steam is merely the medium through which the heat transfers; the substance remains. I will take the samosa, though I suspect the 'hot' is a promise rather than a fact.
answer.thought: Sunil’s correction is practical: he treats the drink as a material object, not a philosophical category. I am tired, and the distinction between the inorganic and the organic is becoming less a matter of spirit and more a matter of digestion. I will accept the food without further metaphysical commentary.
